description: Recolour an image to a game palette so assets from different sources match: PICO-8, Sweetie 16, Endesga 32, Game Boy, NES style or your own hex codes, or reduce it to its own best N colours. Optional ordered dithering for gradients. Transparency is kept. Runs on this computer and saves the results as files.

colors.description: Without palette: reduce to this many of the image's own colours.

dither.description: 0 is flat colour, 1 is strong ordered dithering.

out_dir.description: Folder for the results. Default: next to the input file.

palette.description: pico-8, sweetie-16, endesga-32, gameboy, nes-like, or hex codes like "#1a1c2c #b13e53 ...". Leave out and give colors to use the image's own colours.

path.description: Full path of a PNG or JPG file on this computer. With a GameShipKit Pro key (GAMESHIPKIT_KEY) it can also be a folder, and every image in it is processed.

name: apply_palette
title: Apply a palette
